summary: security lens over drill-transactions-api (22 product path(s), 5a9ff14..a14920d, Codex via the autoreview skill at --max-priority P2): 0 blocking, 1 non-blocking. The route otherwise derives and scopes its raw-row predicate appropriately, validates pinned UUIDs before SQL construction, and audits before transaction reads. However, its timeout implementation leaves timed-out database statements running, creating a concrete resource-exhaustion path on this potentially expensive raw transaction endpoint.
